dates.prior_version_note: Ordinance 7,992-N.S. amended an existing chapter 13.63 (passed to print Nov 18, 2025); published effective dates conflict (Jan 2026 per law-firm alert; Mar 2026 per other sources), and the earlier chapter text is not in the documents.
Council passed the ordinance April 14, 2020; no explicit effective date is stated in the documents.
Just ('good') cause for eviction applied before Measure BB (Nov 2024), which changed some causes and notice requirements; the original enactment date is not stated in the documents.
Relocation amounts are indexed to inflation and reset each January 1; the 2025 amounts applied before the 2026 increase of 1.5%.
The AGA is reset annually (65% of CPI formula approved by voters in Nov 2004); Measure BB (Nov 2024) added the 5% maximum; the 2026 AGA of 1.0% applies no earlier than Jan 1, 2026.
The documents do not state when the interest requirement began.
State screening-fee cap under Civ. Code 1950.6 has applied for years and is CPI-adjusted annually; $68.96 is the 2026 figure; the BMC ch. 13.78 enactment date is not stated.
